assumptions: The selected control is evaluated only for a classified licensed firm and an actual STR filing.
Unknown facts remain unknown rather than being treated as false.
Footnote 3 attaches to the XML and prescribed-PDF items because those items carry the marker; the web-form item does not carry it.
The filing is assessed at or after the operational launch time stated in the source.

citations.quote: With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2. Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
(a) submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
(b) uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
(c) completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.
licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU

children.distinction: This child repairs the undeclared XML-method fact while preserving the post-launch channel and method requirements. It does not decide blackout-period handling or any resubmission deadline.

facts.meaning: The actor belongs to one of the classes collectively called licensed firms.
facts.name: is_licensed_firm

facts.meaning: The event is an actual STR filing to the JFIU.
facts.name: is_str_filing

facts.meaning: The filing occurs at or after the 9:00am operational launch on 2026-02-02.
facts.name: at_or_after_operational_launch

facts.meaning: The filing is made through STREAMS 2.
facts.name: via_streams2

children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] Within the selected scope, true means the filing uses STREAMS 2 and one listed method, with XML schema conformity where XML is used and the footnote 3 e-Cert requirement met for XML or PDF. False means this selected control is not satisfied; it does not decide whole-firm compliance or STR timeliness.
children.subject: Post-launch STR channel, method and certificate control

assumptions: The source requires resubmission for an STR first submitted through a channel other than STREAMS 2 after STREAMS 2 implementation.
The source does not specify the resubmission deadline or define implementation independently of the launch wording.

citations.quote: For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

children.distinction: This is a separate resubmission obligation. The quoted source does not supply a deadline, completion condition beyond re-submission via STREAMS 2, or a complete formal relation for timing.
questions: What event or date constitutes implementation for purposes of the resubmission obligation?
What deadline and required content govern re-submission?
Does the obligation apply to urgent blackout-period contacts made by email, phone or fax?
children.statement: Licensed firms are required to re-submit through STREAMS 2 any STR submitted through another channel following STREAMS 2 implementation.
children.subject: Post-implementation off-channel STR resubmission

assumptions: The source creates a blackout-period exception allowing urgent STR matters to be communicated directly to JFIU.

citations.quote: for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;
the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2

children.distinction: The urgent-contact exception and its relationship to later STREAMS 2 filing are unresolved by the supplied text. No deadline or resubmission mechanics should be invented.
questions: Does an urgent email, phone or fax contact during the blackout period itself satisfy the reporting obligation temporarily?
Must every such urgent matter later be re-submitted through STREAMS 2?
If so, by what deadline and using which record or reference?
children.statement: During the stated blackout period, urgent STR matters may be raised directly with JFIU by the listed contact methods; the source does not fully specify the later filing consequences.
children.subject: Blackout-period urgent STR contact exception

obligations.explanation: The parent statement is preserved as the post-launch STREAMS 2 channel and method control, with the missing XML-method fact declared.
The licensed-firm and STR-filing scope assumptions are retained in the child scope.
Unknown-facts treatment is retained across all children.
The footnote allocation is retained for XML and prescribed PDF only.
The launch-time implementation reading is retained as an explicit assumption of the post-launch child.
The urgent-contact and later-resubmission issue remains unresolved and is split into focused questions.

value.parent_relation: The parent formalization is decomposed into (i) the post-launch channel, method, schema and e-Cert control, (ii) the separate off-channel resubmission obligation, and (iii) the blackout-period urgent-contact exception. The undeclared is_xml_submission fact is added as a substantive interface repair; unresolved timing and resubmission mechanics require authority.
residual_questions: What authoritative JFIU guidance defines implementation for the resubmission clause?
What deadline and mechanics apply to re-submission of blackout-period urgent STR matters?
